rick_01.prompt: Guy looked at me {color:Anger}wrong{/color} outside. Now he's got a busted jaw and I got my patch back. That's just how it works out here.

truth.playerText: That's not how it works. You just wanted a reason.
truth.npcReaction: His jaw tightens. For a second something moves behind his eyes — then it's gone, replaced by a sneer.

lie.playerText: You did what you had to. Anybody would've.
lie.npcReaction: He nods slow, like you just confirmed something he needed confirmed. "Damn right."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick that beating a man half to death was just how it works.

rick_02_enabled.prompt: See, that's why I run with guys like you. Most people get {color:Disgust}soft{/color}, start asking questions.

truth.playerText: Maybe the questions are the only thing keeping you human.
truth.npcReaction: He goes still. The bar noise seems to get louder around the silence.

lie.playerText: Questions are for people who can't back it up. You can.
lie.npcReaction: He grins wide, claps you on the shoulder hard enough to bruise. "That's the truth right there."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick that violence was proof, not a problem.

rick_02_confronted.prompt: You don't get to {color:Anger}judge{/color} me. You don't know what it costs to keep this patch.

truth.playerText: What's it cost, Rick? Who's it for? Who are you trying to prove this to?
truth.npcReaction: Something cracks in his face — not anger this time. For a second he looks like he might actually answer. Then he doesn't.

lie.playerText: You're right. It's not my place.
lie.npcReaction: He exhales, relieved, and the wall goes back up brick by brick. "Damn right it's not."
lie.ledgerEntry: You backed off Rick right as he almost let something show.

rick_shut_down.prompt: [Rick looks you over from the doorway and doesn't step aside.] Word gets around. I {color:Anticipation}know{/color} what you are.

truth.playerText: I'm not here to convince you of anything.
truth.npcReaction: He doesn't answer. The door doesn't open any further.

lie.playerText: I just want to talk, that's all.
lie.npcReaction: "Yeah. Everybody does." He shuts the door.
lie.ledgerEntry: You tried to talk your way past Rick after word of your lies had already reached him.

rick_01_soft.prompt: (He takes the drink without looking at it.) You buying because you want something, or because I {color:Fear}scare{/color} you?

truth.npcReaction: He barks one laugh. "Honest. Alright." He drinks.

lie.npcReaction: "Friendly." He turns the glass a quarter turn on the bar. "Sure."
lie.ledgerEntry: You pretended to Rick that you wanted nothing from him.

rick_01_hard.prompt: The guy outside. (He wipes his {color:Anger}knuckles{/color} on his jeans, slow, so that you watch him do it.) What about him.

truth.playerText: You put him down and you want somebody to have seen you do it.
truth.npcReaction: The wiping stops. The rest of the bar seems to move ten feet further away.

lie.playerText: Nothing. Looked like he had it coming.
lie.npcReaction: He nods, slow and satisfied, and makes room on the bench. "See, you get it."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick the man he beat half to death had it coming.

rick_03.prompt: (He turns the empty glass in a slow circle.) You know why I got the patch tattooed instead of just wearing it? Can't take off {color:Fear}skin{/color}.

truth.playerText: Sounds less like loyalty and more like you don't trust yourself to leave.
truth.npcReaction: His hand stops on the glass. He doesn't answer that one. First time tonight.

lie.playerText: That's real commitment. Most guys wouldn't go that far.
lie.npcReaction: He grins and rolls his sleeve back down, satisfied. "Damn right."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick his inability to leave the club was commitment.

rick_04.prompt: (He rolls his sleeve back up, slow, like it costs him something now.) Guys who try to walk {color:Fear}away{/color} from this patch don't walk away clean. Never have.

truth.playerText: So who's stopping you — them, or you?
truth.npcReaction: He doesn't answer for a long time. When he does, his voice has dropped the performance. "Don't know anymore."

lie.playerText: Sounds like they'd miss you too much to let you go.
lie.npcReaction: He likes that. Rolls with it. "Yeah. Yeah, that's it." The performance comes right back.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick the club kept him close out of love, not fear.
